verdict.rationale: Browser Use is itself a task-delegation agent: you give it a goal and get the result (runs.create("Find the top Hacker News story"), "Give a high-accuracy browser agent a goal and get the result"). Sessions carry multiple runs, events can be polled to monitor progress, and human checkpoints handle 2FA. Community users report delegating real tasks such as LinkedIn automation. Missing for 10: no evidence of a built-in conversational UI for delegating tasks inside the product, since delegation is shown only through the API/SDK and library.
